# `kernel/fs` — the file-system layer of the 4.5BSD kernel

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains the file-system layer of the 4.5BSD kernel.

`config.mk` records 6 source file(s) here: `isofs.c`, `tmpfs.c`, `vfs.c`, `vfs_bio.c`, `vfs_cache.c`, `pagecache.c`.

Subdirectories: `isofs/`, `miscfs/`, `nfs/`, `ufs/`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文

本目录包含4.5BSD 内核的文件系统层。

`config.mk` 记录了 6 个源文件：`isofs.c`、`tmpfs.c`、`vfs.c`、`vfs_bio.c`、`vfs_cache.c`、`pagecache.c`。

子目录：`isofs/`、`miscfs/`、`nfs/`、`ufs/`。

这些 `config.mk` 清单来自 4.5BSD 源码树，是参考元数据；BSD45 的构建脚本（`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`）会显式选择实际参与编译的文件。
